name: Amazon Negative Review Compliance - Collector & Human Review Queue

parameters.content:
## Architecture: browser-owned HTML

Codex/user browser renders the Amazon review page. This workflow starts only after HTML arrives through the webhook. It persists raw HTML, parses deterministically, deduplicates, analyzes only new/changed reviews, and keeps every Amazon action behind a human gate.

## API input

POST raw rendered HTML as text/plain. Required query params: asin, star_filter, source_url, submission_id. Optional: client_id, brand_id, brand_name, notify. The submission_id makes retries idempotent.

## Human gate
Cases stop in amazon_review_moderation_cases and Slack. Any submission to Amazon belongs in a separate approved workflow.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO amazon_review_jobs(
 id,submission_key,run_id,marketplace,asin,star_filter,status,browser_task_id,browser_cost_usd,browser_step_count,
 browser_session_summary,browser_llm_cost_usd,browser_proxy_cost_usd,browser_infra_cost_usd,browser_proxy_used_mb,
 browser_input_tokens,browser_output_tokens,collector_version,collection_mode,created_at,finished_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'RUNNING',$2,0,0,$7::jsonb,0,0,0,0,0,0,$8,$9,now(),NULL)
ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET run_id=EXCLUDED.run_id,status='RUNNING',browser_session_summary=EXCLUDED.browser_session_summary,
 collector_version=EXCLUDED.collector_version,collection_mode=EXCLUDED.collection_mode,error_detail=NULL,finished_at=NULL
RETURNING id job_id,run_id,status,submission_key;

WITH i AS(SELECT $3::text marketplace,$4::text asin,
GREATEST(1,LEAST(3,round(r.rating)::smallint))star_filter,r.review_id,r.rating,
NULLIF(r.title,'')title,NULLIF(r.body,'')body,NULLIF(r.review_date,'')review_date_text,r.verified_purchase,
NULLIF(r.variant,'')variant,r.review_url,md5(concat_ws('|',r.rating,lower(trim(COALESCE(r.title,''))),
lower(trim(COALESCE(r.body,''))),COALESCE(r.review_date,''),lower(trim(COALESCE(r.variant,'')))))content_hash
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($7::jsonb)r(review_id text,rating numeric,title text,body text,review_date text,
verified_purchase boolean,variant text,review_url text)),old AS(SELECT q.marketplace,q.review_id,q.content_hash
FROM amazon_reviews q JOIN i ON i.marketplace=q.marketplace AND i.review_id=q.review_id),u AS(
INSERT INTO amazon_reviews(marketplace,review_id,rating,title,body,review_date_text,verified_purchase,variant,
review_url,content_hash)SELECT marketplace,review_id,rating,title,body,review_date_text,verified_purchase,variant,review_url,content_hash FROM i
ON CONFLICT(marketplace,review_id)DO UPDATE SET rating=EXCLUDED.rating,title=EXCLUDED.title,body=EXCLUDED.body,
review_date_text=EXCLUDED.review_date_text,verified_purchase=EXCLUDED.verified_purchase,variant=EXCLUDED.variant,
review_url=EXCLUDED.review_url,content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,last_seen_at=now(),
last_changed_at=CASE WHEN amazon_reviews.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content_hash THEN now() ELSE amazon_reviews.last_changed_at END
RETURNING *),ln AS(INSERT INTO amazon_review_asins(marketplace,review_id,asin,star_filter)
SELECT marketplace,review_id,asin,star_filter FROM i ON CONFLICT(marketplace,review_id,asin)
DO UPDATE SET star_filter=EXCLUDED.star_filter,last_seen_at=now()),ju AS(UPDATE amazon_review_jobs SET status=$8,
 browser_task_id=$6,pages_visited=$9,collection_complete=$10,stop_reason=$11,error_detail=$12,
 browser_cost_usd=$20,browser_step_count=$21,browser_session_summary=$22::jsonb,
 browser_llm_cost_usd=$23,browser_proxy_cost_usd=$24,browser_infra_cost_usd=$25,
 browser_proxy_used_mb=$26,browser_input_tokens=$27,browser_output_tokens=$28,
 collector_version=$29,collection_mode=$30,finished_at=now()
WHERE id=$1),cap AS(UPDATE amazon_review_page_captures SET
 parse_status=CASE WHEN $8='SUCCEEDED' THEN 'PARSED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
 parser_version=$32,parse_error=$12,parsed_at=now() WHERE job_id=$1),snap AS(INSERT INTO amazon_asin_rating_snapshots(
 marketplace,asin,total_ratings,star_counts,source_url,run_id,browser_task_id)
SELECT $3,$4,NULLIF($31::jsonb->>'total_ratings','')::bigint,
 COALESCE($31::jsonb->'star_counts','{}'::jsonb),NULLIF($31::jsonb->>'source_url',''),$2,$6
WHERE jsonb_typeof($31::jsonb)='object' AND $31::jsonb<>'{}'::jsonb RETURNING 1),ch AS(
SELECT u.* FROM u LEFT JOIN old o ON o.marketplace=u.marketplace AND o.review_id=u.review_id
WHERE o.review_id IS NULL OR o.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM u.content_hash OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM amazon_review_analyses z WHERE z.marketplace=u.marketplace AND z.review_id=u.review_id
 AND z.content_hash=u.content_hash AND z.policy_version=$17 AND z.prompt_version=$18 AND z.model_name=$19
 AND z.decision<>'ANALYSIS_FAILED'))
SELECT true analysis_needed,$1::text job_id,$2::text run_id,$14::text client_id,$15::text brand_id,
$16::text brand_name,$4::text asin,to_jsonb(ch)review FROM ch
UNION ALL SELECT false,$1,$2,$14,$15,$16,$4,'{}'::jsonb WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ch);

values.content: Conservative Amazon review policy triage. Legitimate negative opinions are allowed. Use only supplied evidence. Never infer abuse, compensation, conflict, wrong product, or illegality without explicit text. evidence_excerpt must be exact. Output JSON only. Never authorize automatic reporting.

parameters.query:
WITH a AS(INSERT INTO amazon_review_analyses(id,run_id,marketplace,review_id,content_hash,
policy_version,prompt_version,model_name,decision,policy_categories,confidence,evidence_excerpt,evidence_valid,
explanation,recommended_action,requires_second_review,raw_result,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens)VALUES(md5($4||'|'||$5||'|'||$6||'|'||$7||'|'||$9),
$2,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10,$11::jsonb,$12,$13,$14,$15,$16,$17,$18::jsonb,$24,$25,$26)ON CONFLICT(marketplace,review_id,content_hash,policy_version,prompt_version,model_name) DO UPDATE SET
 decision=EXCLUDED.decision,policy_categories=EXCLUDED.policy_categories,confidence=EXCLUDED.confidence,
 evidence_excerpt=EXCLUDED.evidence_excerpt,evidence_valid=EXCLUDED.evidence_valid,explanation=EXCLUDED.explanation,
 recommended_action=EXCLUDED.recommended_action,requires_second_review=EXCLUDED.requires_second_review,raw_result=EXCLUDED.raw_result,
 input_tokens=EXCLUDED.input_tokens,output_tokens=EXCLUDED.output_tokens,total_tokens=EXCLUDED.total_tokens,created_at=now() RETURNING id),
ar AS(SELECT id FROM a UNION ALL SELECT id FROM amazon_review_analyses WHERE marketplace=$4 AND review_id=$5
AND content_hash=$6 AND policy_version=$7 AND prompt_version=$8 AND model_name=$9 LIMIT 1),ci AS(
INSERT INTO amazon_review_moderation_cases(id,run_id,marketplace,review_id,analysis_id,client_id,brand_id,brand_name,
asin,status,priority)SELECT md5('case|'||$4||'|'||$5||'|'||ar.id),$2,$4,$5,ar.id,$19,$20,$21,$22,'PENDING_REVIEW',
CASE WHEN $17::boolean THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END FROM ar WHERE $23::boolean ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT $1::text job_id,$2::text run_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ci)case_created;

SELECT $1::text run_id,count(*)::integer candidate_count,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_cost_usd),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_cost_usd,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_llm_cost_usd),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_llm_cost_usd,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_proxy_cost_usd),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_proxy_cost_usd,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_infra_cost_usd),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_infra_cost_usd,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_proxy_used_mb),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_proxy_used_mb,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_input_tokens),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_input_tokens,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(j.browser_output_tokens),0) FROM amazon_review_jobs j WHERE j.run_id=$1)browser_output_tokens,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(z.input_tokens),0) FROM amazon_review_analyses z WHERE z.run_id=$1)ai_input_tokens,
(SELECT COALESCE(sum(z.output_tokens),0) FROM amazon_review_analyses z WHERE z.run_id=$1)ai_output_tokens,
COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
'case_id',m.id,'brand_name',m.brand_name,'client_id',m.client_id,'asin',m.asin,'review_id',m.review_id,
'rating',r.rating,'review_url',r.review_url,'decision',a.decision,'policy_categories',a.policy_categories,
'confidence',a.confidence,'evidence_excerpt',a.evidence_excerpt,'requires_second_review',a.requires_second_review)
ORDER BY m.priority DESC,a.confidence DESC),'[]'::jsonb)cases FROM amazon_review_moderation_cases m
JOIN amazon_review_analyses a ON a.id=m.analysis_id JOIN amazon_reviews r ON r.marketplace=m.marketplace
AND r.review_id=m.review_id WHERE m.run_id=$1 AND m.status='PENDING_REVIEW';

return [{json:{run_id:d.run_id,case_ids:d.case_ids,success:!e}}];

WITH u AS(UPDATE amazon_review_moderation_cases SET status=CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN 'NOTIFIED' ELSE status END,
notified_at=CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN now() ELSE notified_at END,updated_at=now()
WHERE id IN(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))RETURNING id)
SELECT $1::text run_id,$3::boolean success,count(*)::integer updated FROM u;

WITH src AS(
 SELECT $1::text job_id,$2::text run_id,$3::text marketplace,$4::text asin,$5::smallint star_filter,
 $6::text browser_task_id,$8::text capture_status,$9::text capture_error,
 r.page_number,r.requested_url,r.final_url,r.html
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($7::jsonb)r(page_number integer,requested_url text,final_url text,html text)
),ins AS(
 INSERT INTO amazon_review_page_captures(id,run_id,job_id,marketplace,asin,star_filter,page_number,
 requested_url,final_url,html,html_hash,html_bytes,browser_task_id,capture_status,parse_status,parse_error)
 SELECT concat(job_id,':',page_number),run_id,job_id,marketplace,asin,star_filter,page_number,
 requested_url,NULLIF(final_url,''),html,md5(html),octet_length(html),browser_task_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(capture_status,''),'FAILED'),'PENDING',NULLIF(capture_error,'') FROM src
 ON CONFLICT(job_id,page_number)DO UPDATE SET final_url=EXCLUDED.final_url,html=EXCLUDED.html,
 html_hash=EXCLUDED.html_hash,html_bytes=EXCLUDED.html_bytes,browser_task_id=EXCLUDED.browser_task_id,
 capture_status=EXCLUDED.capture_status,parse_status=CASE WHEN amazon_review_page_captures.html_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.html_hash THEN 'PENDING' ELSE amazon_review_page_captures.parse_status END,
 parse_error=CASE WHEN amazon_review_page_captures.html_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.html_hash THEN EXCLUDED.parse_error ELSE amazon_review_page_captures.parse_error END,
 captured_at=now() RETURNING id,page_number,html_hash,html_bytes,capture_status
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ins) ORDER BY page_number),'[]'::jsonb)captures FROM ins;

WITH src AS(
 SELECT $1::text job_id,$2::text run_id,$3::text marketplace,$4::text asin,$5::smallint star_filter,
 $6::text browser_task_id,$8::text capture_status,$9::text capture_error,
 r.page_number,r.requested_url,r.final_url,r.html
 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($7::jsonb)r(page_number integer,requested_url text,final_url text,html text)
),ins AS(
 INSERT INTO amazon_review_page_captures(id,run_id,job_id,marketplace,asin,star_filter,page_number,
 requested_url,final_url,html,html_hash,html_bytes,browser_task_id,capture_status,parse_status,parse_error)
 SELECT concat(job_id,':',page_number),run_id,job_id,marketplace,asin,star_filter,page_number,
 requested_url,NULLIF(final_url,''),html,md5(html),octet_length(html),browser_task_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(capture_status,''),'FAILED'),'PENDING',NULLIF(capture_error,'') FROM src
 ON CONFLICT(job_id,page_number)DO UPDATE SET final_url=EXCLUDED.final_url,html=EXCLUDED.html,
 html_hash=EXCLUDED.html_hash,html_bytes=EXCLUDED.html_bytes,browser_task_id=EXCLUDED.browser_task_id,
 capture_status=EXCLUDED.capture_status,parse_status=CASE WHEN amazon_review_page_captures.html_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.html_hash THEN 'PENDING' ELSE amazon_review_page_captures.parse_status END,
 parse_error=CASE WHEN amazon_review_page_captures.html_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.html_hash THEN EXCLUDED.parse_error ELSE amazon_review_page_captures.parse_error END,
 captured_at=now() RETURNING id,page_number,html_hash,html_bytes,capture_status
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ins) ORDER BY page_number),'[]'::jsonb)captures FROM ins;
